title: Bướm đêm bên cửa
about: Round 41, thu-vien ("tôi thấy không hay, bạn hãy sáng tác theo ý của bạn và dùng bộ sound phù hợp"), Nocturnes for an Old Library, A Moth at the Window: a moth at a lit window, B minor at 56 bpm: a light fluttering figure (F#-E-F#) settling on D, again and again a little differently; under it the chord broken up and down in eighths in the middle (texture arp); the middle in D major. The piano alone, on thu-vien (ke-chuyen-gan's grand, hall and echo, with nothing heavy: no Rhodes, the lows not lifted, the left hand from C3 with no octave); a singing line in periods, a question and an answer, each return varied; soft, a gentle swell in the middle, no climax. An original tune.
